collection.title: SUBSIDE context layers
collection.description: Basemap / reference overlays the SUBSIDE map discovers and renders dynamically. Register a WMS, XYZ, vector-tile, or GeoJSON layer here and it appears in the map's Reference panel with no frontend deploy.

layers.title: Stable GNSS marks (NGS)
layers.attribution: NOAA National Geodetic Survey (NGS) Datasheets, via ArcGIS
layers.description: NGS Datasheet control marks that are GNSS-usable (SAT_USE=Y) and physically stable (stability class A or B, i.e. marks expected to hold their position/elevation well; ~72k of ~1M datasheets). These are the stable reference marks the SUBSIDE velocity workflow ties relative InSAR (OPERA DISP-S1) velocities to — InSAR displacement is relative, so a stable, satellite-suitable ground mark gives an absolute reference / validation point. CORS_ID flags continuously-operating reference stations. Loaded viewport-by-viewport from the NGS FeatureServer; zoom to ~county level to see marks. See the NGS datasheet field reference: https://geodesy.noaa.gov/DATASHEET/dsdata.pdf
